# en-email

## Good example

Subject: Missing warranty certificates for PO 3107

Hi Priya,

Thanks for getting the 15 printers to us yesterday. They all work. The one thing still outstanding is the warranty paperwork: the certificates you sent cover 12 units, and the three with serial numbers ending 417, 418 and 422 aren't listed.

We can't sign the Acceptance record until we have the full set. Could you send certificates for those three by Friday 13 November? A PDF by email is fine, and the originals can come with the technician next month.

If those three units are covered by a different distributor, please tell me, because the contract names a single warranty provider and I'd need to raise that with our Contracting Officer first.

The technician's visit is booked for the first week of December, so tell me if that changes and I'll arrange building access ahead of time.

Thanks for your help.

Best,

Nadia Example
Procurement

## Pair 1

### Before

Subject: Late Delivery of 20 Laptops

Dear Director,

I hope this email finds you well. It is important to note that the 20 laptops due under our contract with Acme Sample Ltd have not all arrived, and the agreed delivery date of 5 November 2026 has passed.

Furthermore, under the contract, Liquidated Damages now apply for each day the goods remain undelivered. Moreover, we are highly committed to resolving this quickly so that we can foster the seamless continuation of our team's work without further disruption.

Please send us a revised delivery schedule by 10 November 2026. It should give the expected delivery date, the number of units in each shipment, and the name and contact details of the person responsible for the delivery.

If there is a reason for the delay that we should consider, please provide notification to us in writing and attach any supporting documents. We will conduct a review of it in line with the contract.

Thank you for your attention to this. I look forward to your reply.

Kind regards,

Maya Example
Procurement Officer

## Pair 2

### Before

Subject: Invoice INV-077 Cannot Be Processed

Dear Sir or Madam,

I hope this email finds you well. It is important to note that we cannot process invoice INV-077 yet because the signed Acceptance record was not attached. We conducted a careful check of the file to be sure nothing had been overlooked, and the record is missing.

Moreover, we need the Acceptance record for the verification of the invoice and the release of payment under our agreement. Furthermore, it confirms that the goods or services were received and meet the agreed requirements. Without it, we cannot finish the review or continue with payment, and payment will be delayed.

Please supply the signed Acceptance record by 13 November 2026. You can reply to this email with it attached, or deliver it to our Finance Department during office hours. Once we have it, we will resume processing the invoice as soon as possible.

If you have any questions about this request, please contact me using the details below. We are truly glad to help with any part of the process.

Thank you.

Kind regards,

Tom Example
Finance Department
Fictional Supplies Inc.
